title: 第16章 斩杀雷云豹第17章 奠元天
content_zh:
“必须得是尽快解决掉这头畜生了！”
肖恩知道仅凭着自己的身体力量很难强行破开这雷云豹王的身体防御。
而且这雷云豹实力极强，浑身雷纹缭绕，浑身上下根本就没有办法寻找得到要害部位可以出手攻击。
真正能够让肖恩捕捉得到的只有雷云豹的眼睛了，但正常的情况下出手，同样的只是个空想而已，出剑再快，也没有眼睛的一张一合快。
而这种恶斗，同样是对肖恩极为不利。
毕竟，雷云豹比肖恩足足高出了一个大境界，缠斗下去，就算是耗，也能把肖恩耗死。
肖恩似乎一时之间也是苦无对策。
“吼！”
而就在肖恩苦无对策时，一道暴怒吼声，则是犹如雷鸣般的传来，显然是那雷云豹在咆哮。
而面对着肖恩的难缠，那雷云豹也是愈发的有些暴躁起来，显然，这种持续不断的缠斗，已经消耗了它为数不多的耐性。
它盯着肖恩，旋即脸庞上露出一抹狞笑，有着森森凶残涌动着。
山谷内，气氛陡然间紧绷，一道道目光极为眼红的望着不远处的战况，雷云豹的陡然暴怒，让得他们呼吸都是有些加重。
所有人都知道，或者接下来就是决定他们生死命运的时刻。
暴怒起来的雷云豹两爪在身前舞动，随着它的动作，头颅表面浮现出一层诡异的银色光晕，并随着他的动作闪烁不定起来。
周围虚空不时浮现出点点雷光，源源不断的汇聚到了头颅之中。
此刻雷光缭绕的雷云豹，远比任何时候都要强大得多，那种暴戾和凶残，犹如远古穿越而来的雷兽，正在肆虐着灭世之威。
“福伯，怎么办？”
雅儿的面色也是彻彻底底的难看下来，雷云豹强横的实力，她看得清清楚楚，现在雷云豹似乎在激发天赋血脉，若是肖恩落败的话，他们恐怕在劫难逃。
“放心吧，拼到这个份上，孩子会有机会的！”
福伯显然没有众人的那种慌乱，他缓缓的道。

随着战斗，尽管肖恩没有展现出丝毫的优势，但福伯反倒是越来越有信心。
一个大境界的差距，他比谁都清楚，没有惊人的手段，是不可能弥补这种巨大差距的。
很明显，在肖恩身上，他已经看到了这个可能。
此时的肖恩，他望着瞬间疯狂起来的雷云豹，略显青涩的脸庞，却是隐藏着一抹不为人知的笑容。
他最害怕的就是继续苦斗下去，却没有想到，这雷云豹比他还要焦躁，直接展开了拼命的架势。
在某种程度上，这完全符合了肖恩的战斗思路。
“吼！”
一道怒吼在谷中回荡，所有人只觉虚空顿时剧烈颤动起来，一声声如同滚雷般的闷响从雷云豹体内传出。
在其四周百丈处，泥土翻动，岩石崩裂，大片雷光，在半空交织闪动下，化为一片滚滚雷海的一压而下，将肖恩所在的方圆数百丈空间全都笼罩其中。
肖恩身处雷海之中，只觉一股千钧重力蓦然压至身体之上，举手投足都变得迟滞了几分。
雷云豹猩红着兽瞳，体表之上，狂涌着滚滚雷光，轰然而至。
轰隆！
肖恩霎时间便是感觉到，万千雷霆，扑面而至。
弥漫着雷海的瞳孔中，又是急速的放大着一道厉影，肖恩同时浸没在愤怒和力量的交织中，而这一刻，一股猛烈的声音意境早已经是凝结在喉咙中。
于是，在雷云豹逼近之际，瞬间爆发了出去！
“吼！”
惊天般的虎吼声，声浪仿如实质，裹挟着震天的凶威，直接化为遁光，遁入了雷云豹的灵魂深处。
轰！
无形的灵魂声波狠狠的震荡着雷云豹的灵魂，尤其是声波当中的神兽血脉威压，更是令到那雷云豹难以承受而陷入了浑噩到了迷糊状态。
轰！

肖恩一拳轰出，直接的是带出嘹响的音爆声音，最后拳头被一层浓郁的光辉包裹着，以闪电般的速度怒轰而出。
轰！
拳头轰在雷云豹王头部之上，爆发出一声轰然巨响，震耳欲聋，雷光炸裂一股强猛的力量直接撕开了这头雷云豹王头部的银弧屏障。
而后，无尽光辉化为暗涌的劲力侵袭而进，巨大的雷云豹王头颅在这等强力重轰之下，生生的向下低了几寸。
紧跟着，肖恩右手铁剑铁芒闪然，仅仅是一闪之间，终于再度狠狠的劈在了那雷云豹王头部中拳的位置上。
content_en:
"We must get rid of this beast as soon as possible!"
Sean knew that it would be difficult to forcefully break through the Thunder Cloud Leopard King's physical defense with his own physical strength alone.
Moreover, this Thunder Cloud Leopard is extremely powerful, with thunder patterns all over its body, making it impossible to find any vital parts of its body to attack.
The only thing that Sean can really capture is the eyes of the Thunder Cloud Leopard, but under normal circumstances, it is just a fantasy. No matter how fast the sword is drawn, it cannot open and close as fast as the eyes.
And this kind of vicious fight is also extremely detrimental to Sean.
After all, the Thunder Cloud Leopard is a whole level higher than Xiao En. If they continue to fight, even if they are exhausted, they can still consume Xiao Xiao to death.
Sean seemed to have no solution for a moment.
"Roar!"
Just when Sean had no idea what to do, a violent roar came like thunder. It was obviously the roar of the Thundercloud Leopard.
Faced with Sean's difficulty, the Thundercloud Leopard also became more and more irritable. Obviously, this continuous struggle had consumed its little patience.
It stared at Sean, and then a grin appeared on its face, filled with ferocity.
In the valley, the atmosphere suddenly became tense. People looked at the battle not far away with extremely jealous eyes. The sudden rage of the Thunder Cloud Leopard made them breathe a little heavier.
Everyone knows that perhaps the next moment is the moment that determines their life and death.
The furious Thundercloud Leopard danced its claws in front of it, and as it moved, a strange silver halo appeared on the surface of its head, which flickered with his movements.
Dots of lightning appeared in the surrounding void from time to time, and they continuously converged into the head.
At this moment, the Thundercloud Leopard surrounded by lightning is far more powerful than ever. It is so violent and ferocious that it is like a thunder beast that traveled through time and space, wreaking havoc on the world.
"Uncle Fu, what should I do?"
Ya'er's face also turned completely ugly. She could clearly see the tyrannical strength of the Thunder Cloud Leopard. Now the Thunder Cloud Leopard seems to be stimulating the talent bloodline. If Xiao Xiao loses, they may be doomed.
"Don't worry, if you work hard enough, your child will have a chance!"
Uncle Fu was obviously not as panicked as everyone else, he said slowly.
As the battle continued, although Sean did not show the slightest advantage, Fubo became more and more confident.
He knew better than anyone else that there was a huge gap in realm. It was impossible to make up for this huge gap without amazing means.
Obviously, in Sean, he has seen this possibility.
At this time, Sean looked at the Thunder Cloud Leopard who went crazy in an instant. His slightly green face had an unknown smile hidden in it.
What he feared most was to continue to fight hard, but he did not expect that the Thunder Cloud Leopard was even more anxious than he was, and directly launched a desperate posture.
To a certain extent, this is completely in line with Sean's fighting ideas.
"Roar!"
A roar echoed in the valley, and everyone felt that the void suddenly trembled violently, and a muffled sound like rolling thunder came from the body of the Thunder Cloud Leopard.
Hundreds of feet around it, the soil was churning, rocks were cracking, and large swaths of lightning flashed in mid-air, turning into a rolling sea of ​​thunder and pressing down, covering the entire space of hundreds of feet around where Sean was.
Sean was in the sea of ​​thunder, and felt a huge force of gravity suddenly pressing down on his body, causing his movements to become a little sluggish.
The Thunder Cloud Leopard's eyes were scarlet, and thunder was rolling on its surface, coming with a crash.
Boom!
Sean instantly felt thousands of thunders coming towards his face.
In the pupils filled with thunder, another sharp shadow quickly enlarged. Sean was immersed in the intertwining of anger and power at the same time. At this moment, a violent voice had already condensed in his throat.
So, as the Thundercloud Leopard approached, an explosion broke out in an instant.go!
"Roar!"
The earth-shattering roar of a tiger, the sound was like substance, carrying the earth-shaking ferocious power, directly transformed into the escaping light, and escaped into the depths of the Thunder Cloud Leopard's soul.
boom!
The invisible soul sound waves violently shook the Thunder Cloud Leopard's soul, especially the pressure of the divine beast's bloodline in the sound waves, which made the Thunder Cloud Leopard unbearable and fell into a state of confusion.
boom!
Sean punched out, causing a loud sonic boom sound. Finally, the fist was wrapped in a layer of rich brilliance and blasted out at lightning speed.
boom!
The fist hit the head of the Thunder Cloud Leopard King, and a loud bang broke out, deafening. The thunder exploded and a powerful force directly tore open the silver arc barrier on the head of the Thunder Cloud Leopard King.
Then, the endless radiance turned into an undercurrent of force and invaded. The huge Thundercloud Leopard King's head was lowered by a few inches under the powerful bombardment.
Immediately afterwards, the iron sword in Sean's right hand flashed with iron light. In just a flash, it finally hit the Thunder Cloud Leopard King's head where he was punched.
